messages:
mia: Quick sync: AWS & GCP listing intake checklist. Need AMI/OVF images, legal-compliant branding asset, customer-facing trial SKU, and publisher portal creds. Can we confirm owners?

tony (solutions): I can own images + packaging. FYI GCP wants OVF + manifest.json with checksums.

priya (sales): I'll handle publisher portal invite + pricing tiers. Need final SKU names by Thurs so sales ops can map trials.

laura (security): Heads up 1: we need an S3 bucket policy review for the AMI artifacts and an updated AUP link in the listing. Also confirm whether the private-offer requires a new KMS key.

tony (solutions): For GCP: sample manifest snippet from their docs:
```
{
  "file": "redwood-inference-ami-v1.0.ovf",
  "sha256": "<sha256sum>",
  "size": 42839104
}
```

mia: Great. Also AWS asked for a contact person for technical validation window. Tony, can you take that?

tony (solutions): Yup I'll take tech validation. I'll request a 48hr window and schedule a test deploy on our staging account.

priya (sales): Who owns the trial SKU naming? We should follow existing taxonomy: trial-<region>-<pool>. Suggest `trial-eu-dedicated-small`. Thoughts?

mia: That naming works. Keep it short. I'll add mapping to partner sheet.

laura (security): About KMS: Private-offer probably needs a customer-managed key for EU customers. Ops needs to confirm rotation policy. Priya, flag this in the sales checklist for enterprise buyers.

eng-bot: Created ticket INF-2312: "marketplace image ingest + security review" assigned to tony, laura. Due 3 business days.

tony (solutions): I'll upload images to partner s3 location and post checksums here when done. ETA EOD tomorrow.

mia: Action items:
- tony: upload AMI/OVF + manifest (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- laura: run S3 policy + KMS validation (start tomorrow)
- priya: create publisher portal user invites & finalize SKU names (by Thu)
- mia: submit listing bundle to AWS/GCP with contact info (target Mon)

priya (sales): noted. I'll also include pricing JSON and a short trial description for the marketplace listing.

laura (security): If we get a pentest request from AWS during validation, loop me in immediately.

mia: Thanks team. I'll post partner-drive links in the PR once uploads are complete. :rocket:
